name: experimental smart arrow
description: This experimental arrow is equipped with active stabilization and targeting systems for perfect accuracy, even when hitting small or moving targets. While only decently damaging, this arrow was designed for special forces when stealth is necessary. A simple teleport system even returns the arrow to the user after firing.
